stories.title: Imelda Cajipe Endaya Becomes First Woman Named National Artist of the Philippines
stories.sum: Filipina artist Imelda Cajipe Endaya was named to the Order of National Artists of the Philippines for Visual Arts on September 1, becoming the first woman to receive the honor in its fifty-four-year history.

stories.title: New York Returns 36 Antiquities Worth $5 Million to Syria
stories.sum: On September 23, the office of Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg announced that 36 trafficked or looted antiquities—collectively valued at over $5 million—would be returned to the people of Syria.

stories.title: National Gallery of Victoria Staffer Accused of Siphoning $8 Million from Museum
stories.sum: A former senior employee at the National Gallery of Victoria (NGV) in Australia is said to have drained $8 million from the institution’s coffers over a six-year span, The Guardian reports.

stories.title: Sotheby’s is Selling One of the World’s Most Coveted Whisky Bottles
stories.sum: The auction—Sotheby’s first-ever held at the Macallan Estate—also features bottles designed by artists Sir Peter Blake, Valerio Adami, and Michael Dillon.

stories.title: As the Turner Prize Showcase Opens in Middlesbrough, Meet the 2026 Nominees
stories.sum: Featuring work spanning reimagined military medals, metal humanoid figures, the mourning of a mammal and the construction of the M62, the Turner Prize 2026 showcase opens tomorrow.

stories.title: Switzerland’s Fondation Beyeler opens £109.7m expansion
stories.sum: The Basel institution has added three new structures designed by the Swiss architect Peter Zumthor, while also extending its grounds

stories.title: Australia Says OpenAI ‘Infiltrated’ Public Health Care Portal
stories.sum: Australia is exploring potential legal action after an artificial intelligence agent accessed nonpublic information on the country’s universal health care system.

stories.title: Ai Weiwei Exhibits 500 Cast-Iron Combat Helmets at Australia Museum
stories.sum: The work was inspired by a controversy in which Germany declined to send weapons to Ukraine in 2022.

stories.title: Artistic director and theme announced for 2027 Thailand Biennale
stories.sum: The art initiative previously contributed to Documenta 15

stories.title: Jonathan Abbott named CEO and director of LA MOCA
stories.sum: Abbott succeeds Ann Goldstein, who was interim director from August 2025

stories.title: London's Courtauld and National Portrait Gallery announce partnership for aspiring curators
stories.sum: The partnership will allow MA Curating students at the Courtauld Institute of Art to gain practical experience within the National Portrait Gallery

stories.title: Artists at Spring Break Art Show Tackle Life's Crushing Burdens
stories.sum: Fair participants touch on politics and current events through their own lens and invite others to do the same.

stories.title: Independent 20th Century, the Mise en Abyme of Art Fairs
stories.sum: Despite the mind-boggling amount of spectacular art on view, I was reminded at each turn that the Breuer Building has been turned into an art mall.

stories.title: What you need to know about the OpenAI Australian government hack
stories.sum: The BBC’s North America technology correspondent Lily Jamali explains how the Medicare breach happened, and why it matters.

stories.title: Museums are Embracing AI, But When Will Policy and Funding Catch Up?
stories.sum: A joint report from UNESCO and the International Council of Museums has identified a disconnect between institutions’ use of AI and the structures needed support its responsible use.
